name: state
meaning: the cage state (JailState); access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: targetVert
meaning: PostLoadInit writes it from pos.y (+0xe) at 0x4cf7d8, not from heightTop; it only equals heightTop because SetPosition had already moved the cage there. Jail_Reset does copy +0x68 directly

name: heightTop
meaning: the highest of the three path heights (sorted in PostLoadInit); access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: heightMiddle
meaning: the middle path height; access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: heightBottom
meaning: the lowest path height; access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: delay
meaning: ms before the cage starts moving (0x400 when sent up, 0 otherwise); access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: previousPos
meaning: position at the start of the frame; access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: topSwitch
meaning: PROPERTY object at offset 0; access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: bottomSwitch
meaning: PROPERTY object at offset 4; access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: middleSwitch
meaning: PROPERTY object at offset 8; access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: carryBox
meaning: built from the HIGHEST-index model box with flags&1 (the scan at 0x4cf486 decrements), and Box.flags bit 0 means NON-solid, so the source is a trigger volume. World-space, top raised 200 (0x4cf5a1 sub eax,0xc8). The flags dword at +0x88 is never written

name: clearBox
meaning: its top sits exactly 60 units below the cage's underside (clear.min.y = carry.max.y + 60 per 0x4cf736-0x4cf7bb), NOT ~260 — the 200-unit raise makes the volume deeper, it does not displace it. While anything overlaps it the cage will not move in either direction

name: lowerBox
meaning: the model box whose centre is lowest (largest y: y points down); access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: upperBox
meaning: the model box whose centre is highest (smallest y); access width proven by the byte match of src/objects/jail.cpp

name: soundHandle
meaning: motor sound 0xb2, volume 0xff, SoundPlayFlags 3 (the 4th argument is flags, not a priority)

name: open
meaning: the reads are 0x4cfc7a (msg 0x4300) and 0x4cfcad (msg 0x4301), and ONLY the SetState call is gated on it - targetVert and startDelayMs are written unconditionally in both message arms
